title: A straw for someone drowning
literal_meaning: A drowning person relies on a strand of straw.
meaning_odia: ବୁଡ଼ିଯାଉଥିବା ଲୋକ କୁଟାଖିଅକୁ ବି ଆଶ୍ରା କରୁଛି—ଏହା ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ଚିତ୍ର। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ, ଘୋର ବିପଦରେ ମଣିଷ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ସାହାଯ୍ୟର ସମ୍ଭାବନାକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭରସା କରିବାର କଥା ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି। କୁଟା ତାକୁ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଉଦ୍ଧାର କରିବ ବୋଲି ପଙ୍କ୍ତି କହୁନାହିଁ।
explanation: The danger is immense and the thing relied on is tiny. Read editorially, the contrast shows how desperation can make even a slight possibility of help feel worth holding onto. The line describes reliance without promising that the support will be enough.
usage_example: Original imagined example: After several attempts to solve an urgent problem fail, someone puts their remaining hope in a small lead. A friend recalls the drowning person’s reliance on a straw.
cultural_context: ଆଶ୍ରା names support or reliance. The smallness of କୁଟାଖିଅ intensifies the person’s need; the image concerns a hoped-for way through danger rather than something already recovered afterward.

witnesses.locator: Page31, seventh item beginning ବୁଡିଗଲା ଲୋକର.

english_summary: In desperation, even the slightest support becomes a hope.
